relations.subject: Friedhelm Ernst Hardy
relations.evidence: Friedhelm Ernst Hardy (1943 – 4 August 2004), also known as Fred Hardy, was Professor of Indian Religions, teaching at King's College London.

relations.subject: Friedhelm Ernst Hardy
relations.evidence: He began studying Sanskrit in Cologne before moving on to his doctoral work at Oxford University in 1967.
